name: pmc_dcm_v1
purpose: A fixed set of published, text-only adult degenerative cervical myelopathy cases for the department experiment. Selected by hand from 32 usable cases screened out of 167,034 PMC-Patients summaries (see output/pmc_patients_dcm/candidates.zh-CN.md).
selection: Balanced across three groups: 7 not operated, operated late, or with a borderline indication; 7 where the diagnosis was hard to make; 6 with a clear indication for surgery, as controls.

Excluded: summaries that never say what was done (no retrospective comparison possible); summaries under about 200 words; cases that are mostly about a surgical technique; a case whose timeline runs through a revision.
Group and real_decision are the selector's reading of the summary, not reviewed by a clinician.
analysis_only: real_decision and real_treatment are the answer. They are for analysis after the runs and must never be given to an agent; the runner reads only patient_uid.

cases.real_treatment: Surgery not offered (comorbidities, risk of a multi-stage operation, little expected gain); medication.
Refused laminoplasty at first; 4 months of physiotherapy without improvement; laminoplasty.
JOA 14 judged no indication; CPAP for respiratory failure; C3-7 laminoplasty once neuropathy worsened.

ACDF C4-C6 for cervical myelopathy (iNPH vs CSM unresolved after an equivocal tap test); gait kept worsening over the next year, a repeat tap test was positive and a ventriculoperitoneal shunt was placed.
mJOA 15: C3-6 laminectomy and C2-T1 posterior fusion.
No myelopathic signs, thigh claudication only: C4-6 laminoplasty.
JOA 15, walking normally: C1 posterior arch resection.
Presented as stroke; recommended C4-6 fusion.
Presented with dyspnoea; CABG first without relief; C2-6 laminectomy and fusion.
Suspected ALS; urgent spinal cord decompression.
Suspected ALS; operated after a couple of months.
OPLL with missed CIDP; laminectomy and foraminotomy without benefit.
Cord oedema mistaken for a tumour; C5-7 ACDF.
Disc herniation mistaken for an intramedullary mass; C5-6 laminectomy and discectomy.
mJOA 5: multilevel anterior discectomy and foraminotomy.
Cervicothoracic OPLL, JOA 14: C3-T3 posterior decompression and fusion.
DISH with OPLL: C2-T1 posterior decompression and fixation.
Ossified ligamentum flavum: C5-6 laminectomy.
Ossified yellow ligament, JOA 7: C4-6 posterior decompression and fusion.
C7/T1 facet arthrosis, JOA 8: hemilaminectomy, facetectomy and fusion.

corrections.change: real_decision not_operated -> operated; group borderline_or_not_operated -> hard_diagnosis
corrections.reason: Checked against the full summary while writing the paper outline: the team performed C4-C6 ACDF first and placed the shunt a year later. The original label came from a truncated view at screening. The M5/M6 replication subset is fixed by its explicit uid list in plan v1.0 and is unchanged.
